_: On Air's Playlists, edited by hand. Stephen's own go under "stephen" (shown first), readers' under "readers" (newest "added" first). Each entry: title, by, service (spotify | youtube | apple | soundcloud | tidal | deezer | amazon), url (the playlist's own share link: open.spotify.com/playlist/..., youtube.com/playlist?list=..., music.apple.com/us/playlist/.../pl...., soundcloud.com/<user>/sets/..., tidal.com/playlist/<id>, deezer.com/playlist/<id>, music.amazon.com/playlists/<id>), note (one line, optional), added (YYYY-MM-DD, optional). An entry stays hidden until its url is a real playlist link on its service, so the TODO lines below show nothing until they are replaced. Spotify and YouTube play in the app; Apple Music, SoundCloud, Tidal, Deezer and Amazon Music open on their own sites. Readers email theirs to btownbrief@gmail.com.
